description: Find kids' and family events, classes/programs and places in one Grassy Knees metro area, filtered by date, price, age, category and keywords. Returns at most 20 listings, soonest first, each with its grassyknees.com page URL. Dates are in the metro's local time.

age.description: Child's age in years; keeps listings whose published age range includes it (listings without an age range are kept).

end_date.description: End of the custom range, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to start_date.

kind.description: event = dated one-offs (default); program = classes and multi-week series; place = museums, parks, rinks and other places to go; any = all three.

metro.description: Metro id from list_metros (e.g. denver, new-york, washington-dc, dallas-fort-worth). Common names like 'NYC' or 'Dallas' also work.

query.description: Keywords matched against title, description, venue, organizer and address (all words must match), e.g. 'pumpkin', 'library storytime', 'Boulder'.

start_date.description: Start of a custom date range, YYYY-MM-DD (metro local time).

when.description: Date window. Default next-7-days. Ignored when start_date is given.

name: search_activities
title: Search kids' activities in a metro
